scope: Eight fresh-process trials per scenario/version. Public macOS JavaScriptCore C API, distinct context group per invocation, no forced GC, callback/passthrough validation and byte fingerprint/HTTP-count comparison. Cold lyric cases start with completely empty stores, including metadata and palette. NetEase search has 45k unrelated catalog characters. Entry cases include unrelated player data, all below 128 KiB. Churn runs 32 independently empty contexts serially, no queue/timers. Native HTTP is mocked and zero-latency, OS allocation high-water includes harness/engine/JIT and current samples. Not iOS Loon, native bridge buffers, rapid-overlap or VPN acceptance.
